title: elatostema australe
intro: Elatostema australe, commonly known as the Tasmanian watercress, is a type of flowering plant native to Australia and New Zealand. It is a member of the nettle family (Urticaceae) and is known for its medicinal properties. Elatostema australe has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits and medicinal properties.
